#6b3533606c.en: We've received news from the Warchief. Zuluhed and Cho'gall are to be expected withing the coming moons. If you were to see them, Follow your duty as warriors of the Horde and bring them to me. - Kilrogg

#0b8a33d8cb.en: To Vincent, I hope you're doing well, your Nephews and I can't wait to see you! Thanks again for the flowers, their golden petals brings us colors and joy in these dark times. To help you through your way back, I hope these boots will help you get to us faster. - Sarah

Спасибо за цветы — их золотые лепестки приносят нам краски и радость в эти тёмные времена. Чтобы помочь тебе в пути обратно, надеюсь, эти сапоги помогут тебе быстрее добраться до нас. — Сара
